messages:
sarah_sales: Quick one — NimbleHealth wants the on-prem POC platform fee waived and a conversion credit. POC = 8 weeks, installs into their DC, KMS/HSM required.
sarah_sales: Customer proposal: waive platform fee for POC, then $30k credit applied across year 1 if they convert to a 12-mo commit (~$240k ARR target).
ajay_dealdesk: What conversion ARR and timeline? Deal desk needs ARR target, proposed credit, and justification vs standard rate card.
sarah_sales: Target ARR = ~$240k. They want the full $30k otherwise they'll slow the POC.
maria_eng: FYI onprem POC needs eng support: approx 1 eng lead week + 2 weeks SRE = ~120hrs. We also usually bill an onboarding/ops SKU (`ONPREM-SUPPORT-STD`).
kevin_security: KMS note: HSM-backed keys need connector work and cert exchange. Estimate HSM work ~ $10k dev effort or roll into the credit.
kevin_security: Also require audit logs enabled and a test for HSM to validate.
sarah_sales: Proposed: waive POC platform fee, $30k credit on conversion, absorb onboarding hours into credit.
ajay_dealdesk: Two constraints: 1) deal desk cap for platform-credit exceptions is $25k without VP sign-off. 2) Finance/legal want clawback if customer cancels within 6 months.
lisa_finance: Finance ok with a milestone-tied credit. Require signed SOW + first payment before applying credit. If churn <6 months, clawback applies. Need accounting treatment notes.
maria_eng: We can trim SRE scope with a simplified onboarding checklist and cut ~24 hours. Recommend keeping a one-time onboarding fee unless covered by credit.
sarah_sales: Customer pushed for $30k flat. Can we split it: $25k immediate credit + $5k contingent on successful HSM test or SOC2 evidence?
kevin_security: SOC2 timing uncertain. HSM test is controllable if customer provides test hardware — that can gate the last $5k.
ajay_dealdesk: Path forward: approve $25k conditional credit now (deal desk). Extra $5k needs VP sales approval and legal addendum referencing forfeiture and milestones. Also cap total discount (e.g., max 20% first-year discount).
sarah_sales: I'll present that. Need a provisional infra allocation to avoid blocking their 8-week schedule.
deploy-bot: POC environment provisioned: tag=nimble-poc, nodes=2xA100, disk=1TB, network=VPC-peering-ready. Ticket #INFRA-7890. :white_check_mark:
maria_eng: Assigned SRE and trimming checklist. We can shave ~24 hrs from estimate.
lisa_finance: Add exact milestone language: credit applied after signed 12-mo commitment + receipt of first payment. Clawback if canceled within 6 months.
sarah_sales: Updated plan to send to customer: POC platform fee waived, $25k conditional credit (SOW + first payment), additional $5k unlocked by HSM test + VP sign-off. I'll attach draft SOW to the email.
ajay_dealdesk: Provisional approval noted: DEALDESK-PROV-APPROVED ($25k). Route final SOW to legal and cc dealdesk for exec approval of extra $5k.
sarah_sales: looping @kevin_security into SOW for HSM clause. Thanks all.
